crossRefs.note: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish…
They did so, and brought those five kings out of the cave to him: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king…
the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

translations.web: Jarmuth with its pasture lands, En Gannim with its pasture lands: four cities.
translations.bsb: Jarmuth, and En-gannim—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.asv: Jarmuth with its suburbs, En-gannim with its suburbs; four cities.
